gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed and histological proven glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: Addition of Anlotinib Hydrochloride to the Stupp Regimen Versus the Stupp Regimen Alone for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed and histological proven glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Anlotinib hydrochloride will be given with a daily dose of 12 mg for 14 days of a 21-day cycle up to 2 cycles, initiated on the first day of radiation therapy

agents.drug_class_hint: multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGFR/PDGFR/FGFR), approved in China
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: As a novel small molecule multi-target tyrosine kinase inhibitor, anlotinib hydrochloride has been found to be able to inhibit both tumor angiogenesis and cell growth.

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive standard radiation therapy plus temozolomide (Stupp regimen).

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, established GBM therapy (Stupp backbone)

coder_notes: Randomised Stupp + anlotinib vs Stupp alone (registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR), so control_arm_from_other_arms = no. Anlotinib hydrochloride mapped to parent moiety anlotinib. Plain 'glioblastoma' without IDH/WHO reference -> cns5_terminology unclear. No biomarkers, no PK or PD measures.
